一、电流表的扩程

根据测量电压降的定义 $R_{g}$ 包括 $R_{j}$ 和内阻

$$U^{*} = \left( R_{1} + R_{2} + R_{3} + R_{4} + R_{D} \right) I_{g} = \left( R_{1} + R_{2} + R_{3} \right) I_{1} = \left( R_{1} + R_{2} \right) I_{2} = R_{1} I_{3}\tag{1}$$

有

$$\begin{cases}R_{1} = 20\Omega \\R_{1} + R_{2} = 200\Omega \\R_{1} + R_{2} + R_{3} = 2000\Omega \\R_{1} + R_{2} + R_{3} + R_{4} + R_{D} = 5000\Omega\end{cases}\tag{2}$$

解得

$$\begin{cases}R_{1} = 20\Omega \\R_{2} = 180\Omega \\R_{3} = 1800\Omega \\R_{4} + R_{D} = 3000\Omega\end{cases}\tag{3}$$

评分标准:
